title: crepis spathulata subsp. boetica
intro: Crepis spathulata subsp. boetica, commonly known as Spanish hawk's beard, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Crepis spathulata subsp. boetica include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiproliferative effects, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
